rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for feeling or showing surprise.

example.english: I’m really surprised that you finished the report so quickly.
example.traditional: 我真係驚訝你咁快就做完份報告。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zan1 hai6 ging1 ngaa6 nei5 gam3 faai3 zau6 zou6 jyun4 fan6 bou3 gou3

rows.note: Use this when stressing that something was unexpected or that the outcome was not what you anticipated.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 git3 gwo2 ling6 ngo5 hou2 ji3 ngoi6
